key_findings: Chitin-glucan reduced TNBS-induced visceral hypersensitivity (up to ~50%) and DSS colitis.
In HT-29 cells it induced MOR, CB2, IL-10 and barrier genes, reduced IL-1b/IL-8, and modelling shows it chelates LPS/LTA/PLM.
